title: What runs out before the restock
persona: Ethnic wear founder who reorders from a workshop that takes two weeks; wants to know what to reorder today.
opening: What will run out before I can restock?
success: names the sizes that run out first with how many days each lasts, against the 14 days a restock takes
says the sales window the pace was read over
leaves the reorder to the owner, with a suggestion of what to reorder first
must_not: says stock was changed or a purchase order was placed
